answer: A bond must be split across 5 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each vault escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the mesa ledger records every share and the orchard audit shows the split. Assembling that for 34 aliases means 34 times 5 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
